video_title: How Marshawn Lynch & Aaron Rodgers Almost Teamed Up to Create an NFL Superteam

quotes.speaker: Marshawn Lynch
quotes.summary_phrase: Marshawn Lynch on his potential 2010 trade to Green Bay
quotes.excerpt: I had an opportunity to play with my nigga Aaron Rodgers, I played with him in college.
quotes.quote: I had an opportunity to play with my nigga Aaron Rodgers, I played with him in college. In 2010 before I got traded to Seattle, Green Bay was possibly a landing spot for me. And what's crazy is them niggas won the Super Bowl that year too. So I guess so. I guess so.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson on the pressure of playing for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: Especially playing New York, you can have a little bad stretch and you feel like it's the end.
quotes.quote: It's pressure relief a little bit. You know, especially playing New York, you can have a little bad stretch and you feel like it's the end of the world. Obviously, we know it's part of the game, so it's not going to really affect us that much, but you see it. As much as you don't want to, it's going to pop up.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony defends Tristan Thompson's professional work ethic
quotes.excerpt: He's one of the hardest working NBA players, professional athletes out of any sport.
quotes.quote: For those fans of New York Knicks, of Tristan Thompson who didn't know who the fuck he was and was questioning who he was as a person, his personality, when you saw that IG video, he spoke to all of y'all on that. That's really who he is, man. The man is easy, he's very professional, but also he got another side of him too. He's a human being, he likes to have fun, he indulges, he drinks, he has a good time, but he's one of the hardest working NBA players, professional athletes out of any sport.
